articles.summary: Poplar Bluff, Missouri, Oct. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Southern Missouri Bancorp, Inc. (“Company”) (NASDAQ: SMBC), the parent corporation of Southern Bank (“Bank”), today announced preliminary net income for the first quarter of fiscal 2027 of $19.1 million, an increase of $3.4 million, or 22.0%, as compared to the same period of the prior fiscal year.
